# Failed attempts

## Direct summation over the critical strip

Tried expanding the sum termwise and bounding the tail by the trivial estimate. The tail bound is
weaker than the main term for every parameter choice that keeps the sum convergent, so the estimate
never closes. Abandoned 2026-02-03.

## Induction on the block decomposition

The inductive step needs the block boundaries to align, and they do not for odd lengths. Abandoned
2026-03-11 after two attempts to repair the alignment.
